description: This Dart source file defines classes for detecting device security status and handling authentication, specifically for mobile platforms using the local_auth and device_info_plus packages. It contains the DeviceSecurityStatus class representing device security info, and the AuthService class providing methods to evaluate device security and perform authentication.

classes.name: DeviceSecurityStatus
classes.description: Represents the security status of a device, including OS info, biometric support, and security features.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Provides services to evaluate device security status and perform biometric or device credential authentication.

methods.name: getDeviceSecurityStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously gathers information about device OS, biometric support, and security features to return a DeviceSecurityStatus object.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs biometric or device credential authentication, returning true if successful.
